raw.rationale: Nutlin-3 is a selective MDM2 inhibitor that stabilizes p53 and kills TP53-wild-type cells, so lineage selectivity should track TP53 wild-type frequency and MDM2 dependence rather than broad cytotoxicity; most lineages have low baseline selective-kill rates, with modest enrichment in TP53-wild-type-rich lineages such as lung, breast, skin, and CNS. Published PRISM-type screens show nutlin-3 is not broadly lineage-selective at 2.5 µM, so probabilities remain low overall.
